title: RESOLVED - work objective (was: what is the objective?)
summary: RESOLVED 2026-09-23. The user chose a variant of C1 that was broader than any candidate offered: migrate the whole Python server to an npm/React single-page app with no hosted server, provider calls leaving from the user's own IP, Upstage v2 replaced by v3, DevsDo removed, models grouped by provider, design/architecture focus and NOT security. Delivered as app/. U2-U8 remain open and are carried in IC-20260923-react-migration.

facts.claim: RESOLUTION: none of the offered candidates C1/C2/C3 matched exactly. The user specified a full language and architecture migration (Python -> npm/React, hosted server -> local egress from the user's own IP) that subsumed C1 (Upstage v3 swap) and explicitly excluded security work. Offering options did not waste effort - it prompted the user to state a much more specific objective than any option listed.

U1 (GATING): which objective? C1 integrate Upstage v3 into the server; C2 make the project runnable/testable in this sandbox; C3 something else (new feature, different repo, work on the aduskill bundle itself).
evidence: user message contains no task; ACTIVATE.md step 10

evidence: no CI, no commit history beyond 'init', no test results anywhere in the repo

facts.claim: U3: is 'My PREVIOUS ENTIRE SERVER/' the code currently deployed on Hugging Face Spaces, or an archived snapshot? The word PREVIOUS is ambiguous and this determines rollback risk.
evidence: no HF Spaces metadata, no README, no deployment config, single 'init' commit

facts.claim: U4: are provider credentials available to the user, and may they be installed through a protected mechanism? Without them no live test is possible. Secrets must never be pasted into chat.
U5: is console.upstage.ai reachable from this sandbox? api.upstage.ai returned curl exit 000, but that is a different host and does not answer the question.

U6: should dependencies be installed in this sandbox at all, given DrissionPage pulls Chromium and curl-cffi needs a native build? U7: is there a deployment target beyond HF Spaces? U8: why does the repo have no README, CI, .gitignore, or root tests - is hygiene work wanted?
